div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 客户端请求 (Header: Authorization Bearer JWT, Body: session_id, message)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 验证 JWT 签名与有效期

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 返回 401 Unauthorized

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
从 Token 载荷提取可信身份:
jwt_user_id, jwt_role, jwt_tenant_id
(忽略客户端 Body 中伪造的 user_id/tenant_id)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 检查 session_id 是否存在?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
校验 user_session_memory 表:
session.user_id == jwt_user_id
AND session.tenant_id == jwt_tenant_id?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 返回 403 Forbidden 并记录安全审计日志

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
按复合键加载会话上下文:
cache_key = '{jwt_tenant_id}:{jwt_user_id}:{session_id}'

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 创建绑定 jwt_user_id 与 jwt_tenant_id 的新会话

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 识别用户本轮意图

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
用户消息或上下文是否已包含
经确认的 order_id?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
查询 MySQL orders 表:
WHERE user_id = :jwt_user_id
AND status IN ('PAID_SIMULATED','FULFILLED')
(若有 EcomNLU 识别标签则按匹配品类优先排序)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 是否存在可售后候选订单?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 提示用户当前账号下无已支付/已履约订单

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
向前端返回候选订单选择卡片
(严禁后台自动选中最近一单直接退赔!)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 等待用户点击确认具体 order_id 与 order_item_id

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
校验该 order_id 归属:
order.user_id == jwt_user_id?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 允许构建售后申请单提交至 EcomOps
